title: 23.38. Ajjhattārammaṇattika, Kusalattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Naajjhattārammaṇaṁ nakusalaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā ajjhattārammaṇo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā cha …pe… avigate cha.
